tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shin tu spros med kyi dbang bzhugs/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das spros pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ni shin tu spros pa med pa'i dbang rig pa mngon sum du ston pa'i cho ga 'di la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bla ma dang slob ma'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni 'jig rten pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa gzhung las gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi slob mas/ zhu ba phul ba'i dus su lo gsum gyi bar du snod brtags la/ skal ba dang ldan pa gsum tshun chad la dbang sbyin te/ de'i dus su rang gi bla ma las dngos sam yid kyis dbang blang ba dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa brtsams pa dang*/ rig pa mngon sum gyi don nyung ngu yang zhag nyer gcig tu bsgoms te/ slob ma yang dag pa'i lam la sbyor ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa slob ma'i sngon du bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba rnams spangs la/ gsang sngags kyi thabs lam legs par sbyangs nas/ bla ma la mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas la zhu'o/ /cho ga'i dang po ni/ slob ma kun la dri sna tshogs dang*/ me tog dang*/ chu dang 'o ma bsres pas khrus byas nas/ a nyer gcig gis rgyas gdab la/ spyod pa'i sngon 'gror bar chad bsrung bar bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams bla ma'i mdun du langs la/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bla mas slob ma'i bgegs bskrad phyir/ /stod g.yogs dag ni phud nas ni/ / shar du kha bltas stangs stabs bya/ /rnam shes brgyad kyi sgo bsrung phyir/ /yi ge brgyad kyis rgyas gdab bo/ /slob ma'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu yang*/ / hūm̐ gcig sgoms zhes tshig brjod la/ /bla mas ting 'dzin gsal ba yis/ /slob ma'i snying gi rtse mo na/ /dra ba can gyi rtsa nang du/ /hūm̐ dang shes pa bcas pa gzhug /bu lus sngo skya'i hūm̐ du bsgom/ /lte bar raṃ dmar ljang dang mtshungs/ / mgrin par kham ni dud kha 'o/ /dpral bar e ni mthing kha bsgom/ /lkog mar su nyid ser po 'o/

/ha zhes pus mo g.yas bsgoms la/ /yang na rkang mthil phaṭa yig ni/ / sngo nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs su bsgom/ 'di ni 'jig rten gyi bgegs rnams kyi nus pa mi skye bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ slob ma rang gi rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad/ phyis yul la mi skye bar bya ba'i don to/ /de nas yi ge brgyad kyi tha ma phaṭa yig ni ngag tu zlos su yang gzhug go/dbugs re la nyer gcig re bzlas shing dur khrod du btang ngo*/ /de nas slob mas dur khrod du phyin pa dang*/ sha sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma dang*/ me tog sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma gnyis kyis mkha' 'gro ma rnams mchod la/ bdag gi bar chad nye bar zhi bar gyis shig pa'i gsol ba btab la/ lus ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa la zhag gcig bya/ de bzhin du ngag ru shan 'byed pa dang*/ sems ru shan 'byed pa zhag re re byas la/ rjes su phyag dang bskor ba 'don zlos dang*/ chos dang mthun pa'i lus ngag gi spyod lam bya'o/ /ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa dngos ni khrid yig bzhin bya'o/ /sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi la maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang*/ lha ngo bstan pa dang*/ rig pa mngon sum gyi brda' dbang bskur ba dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas shin tu dben par nyi ma rtse shar la slob mas dbul rgyu'i maṇḍal rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ sman lnga/ me tog lnga ste/ lnga tshom lnga bsham/ bla ma'i brda'i maṇḍal me tog kha dog lnga'am/ tshon gyis bris pa gang yang rung ba gcig bya/ mchod pa dang gtor ma ci 'byor ba bsham mo/ /de nas slob ma rnams bla ma'i mdun du phyag byas te/ thal mo sbyar te 'dug la bla mas 'di skad du/ khyod su yin zhes lan gsum mo/ /slob mas kyang bdag skal ldan yid kyi bu gcig lags zhes lan gdab bo/ /yang bla mas/ de ltar yin phan chad rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing nyams dga' ba 'dir zhugs sha

ི ga ces brjod do/ /de dag gi don ni 'khor ba rang rgyud du 'dzin pa'i ming spong ba dang*/ yid kyi rig pa mthong bar bya ba dang*/ dbyings rig gi dkyil 'khor 'di bzang ngo zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas maṇḍal lnga po 'bul te/ bla ma dang rgyal ba sras bcas bdun gyi nam mkha' la dmigs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus la/ /stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad kun/ /gser la sogs pa'i rin chen lngas/ /yongs su gang bar dmigs nas ni/ /bla ma rdo rje can la 'bul/ /de bzhin sna tshogs 'bru lnga dang*/ /dri mchog rnam pa lnga rnams dang*/ /sna tshogs me tog 'di rnams kun/ /bla ma rdo rje can la 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ gu ru maṇḍal pū dza me gha sa mun dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ /zhes 'bul lo/ /de'i don ni/ /rin po che lnga ni ye shes lnga'i ngo bo la longs spyod pa'i brda'o/ /'bru rnam pa lnga ni 'bras bu sku lngar ston cig pa'i brda'o/ /dṛ lnga ni chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dris lus thams cad tshim par mdzod cig pa'i brda'o/ /sman sna tshogs pa ni/ bdag la phyi nang gi sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar mdzod cig pa'i brda'o/ /thun mong gi dngos grub ni tshe gcig la rang gi nor 'phel ba'i don du nor dang*/ de bzhin nyid zad mi shes pa'i phyir na rin po che dang*/ mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i phyir na 'bru dang/ dbang po gsal ba'i phyir na dri dang*/ nad kyi sdug bsngal las grol ba'i phyir ni sman dang*/ shes rab dang dad pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'dod pa'i phyir na me tog dang*/ de dag ni thun mong du thob par bya ba'i phyir yin no/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dmigs la/

ngag tu/ kye kye/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /zag pa rang zad dbyings nas sku bzhengs pa'i/ /dri ma rang dag dbyings las spyan gzigs la/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'-ii don byed pa'i/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ /dgongs pa nyag cig mi g.yo dbyer med pa'i/ /sngon bzhugs dur khrod gnas nas rjes dgongs la/ /rang bzhin mdzad pa gang yang mi mnga' yang*/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos kun tu bzang po'i sku/ /bdag blo mos pa'i don phyir 'dir gshegs la/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kun mnga' rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ /sangs rgyas thub pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /rig 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ / rig 'dzin chen po shrī sing ha dang*/ /rig 'dzin chen po dzñā na su tra dang*/ / rig 'dzin chen po bi ma mi tra dang*/ /rig 'dzin chen po ting 'dzin bzang po dang*/ /gnas brtan ldang ma lhun gyis rgyal mtshan dang*/ /bla ma lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug dang*/ /zhang ston chen po zhe sdang rdo rje dang*/ /bla med brgyud 'dzin nyi ma 'bum dang ni/ /byin brlabs mchog ldan gu ru jo 'ber dang*/ / bla ma chen po saṃ ga la kṣa la/ /bdag blo mos pa'i don phyir gsol ba 'debs/ zhes re re nas brjod pa'am/ spyir yang rung ngo*/ /de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la 'di skad do/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin rnams dgongs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub bsam dpa' rnams te/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'd-i zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos bdag gi lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi ngag byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag gi sems byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi snang ba byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /bla mas kyang*/ dkyil 'khor 'jug don rigs kyi bu/ /'di nyid gsang sngags rnams kyi bcud/ /ma btsal ye nas gnas pa'i don/ /rang la yod pa'i don nyid ni/ /brda la brten nas dmigs la bskur/ /shes rab kyis ni brtags dpyad min/ /dbang po'i sgo la mngon sum du/ /snang ba'i ye shes gtan dbab phyir/ /'di nyid 'khor lo nang du zhugs/ /shes brjod do/ /gnyis pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ 'di thams cad brda yin pas bla mas 'di skad brjod cing bya'o/ /lus chas rab tu phyung mdun du langs la rkang pa gnyis gshibs mig gnyis ma 'gyur bar ltos/ thal mo snying khar sbyor/ bla ma'i thugs kyi dkyil du shes pa gtod/ rang rig pa'i me tog phul zhes bstan to/ /de nas bla mas bu'i sems bzung bar bya ba'i phyir a a zhes drug brtsegs su shes pa yengs su bor ba'i mtshams su brjod/ des ni yid kyi bu gcig pu/ /lus ni g.yo bar nye bar dang*/ /ngag ni smra zhing 'phar ba dang*/ /sems ni bde bas myos pa dang*/ /rig pa tshud pa'i rtags su bshad/ /'di dag gi don ni/ maṇḍal dang rig pa'i me tog 'bul ba ni/ khyad par gyi don te bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis su med pa'o/ /gcer bur phyung ba ni/ rig pa la 'khor ba'i nyes pa med pa'i brda' yin/ lus 'grengs tshugs su 'dug pa ni/ rtag tu nam mkha' dang bral bar mi phyed pa'-i brda' yin/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs pa ni lus thabs cad mig shes rab yin pas mig la shes pa ma 'gyur bar ltos shig ces pa'i brda' yin no/ /thal mo snying khar sbyar ba ni/ rig pa snying la gnas pa'i brda' yin/ bla ma'i thugs kyi dkyil du shes pa gtad pas ni/ bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i brda' yin/

sems gzhan du ma yengs par gyis shig ces pa ni/ rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud la ma yengs par ltos shig pa'i brda' yin no/ /bla mas bu'i shes pa mi btang ba'i phyir a a zhes glu dang bcas pas bcug pas/ ma byas pa'i ye shes rang chas su skye ba'i brda' yin no/ /slob ma'i lus ngag la rtags g.yo ba dang 'phar ba ni/ ye shes de nyid ma byas pa'i ye shes rang lugs su 'bab pa'i brda' yin no/ /gsum pa stong pa nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa ni/ slob ma kha shar gyi phyogs su bltas la nam mkhar 'gro bar bsam du bcug ste/ 'di skad brjod/ e ma skal ldan shar phyogs kyi/ / nam mkha'i khams la phar gam gam song dang*/ /zhes brjod pa'i mtshams dag tu/ 'gro na 'gro sa 'dug gam/ slar ldog na ldog sa 'dug gam/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de bzhin du lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang du yang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bla ma'i phyag gis nam mkha' la lan gsum g.yug par bya'o/ /de dag gi don ni stong pa nyid kyi dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir 'jug pa dang*/ 'gro 'ong gis med pa'i brda' yin/ phyag nam mkha' la lan gsum g.yug pa ni/ snang ba thugs rje 'gag pa med pa sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyed snang gsung gi rang bzhin longs sku'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ mi snang ba thugs kyi ngo bo chos sku'i rang bzhin te/ sku gsum stong gcig pa'i brda' yin no/ /bzhi pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/ slob mas gos gyon skyil krung bcas la/ nam mkhar nyi ma lnga 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba la sems gtod du bcug la/ bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma bu khyod skal dang ldan/ /nam mkha'i steng du yar ltos dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba de la shes pa gtod la je mtho je mthor thung zhig /ces lan gsum brjod pa'i 'og tu/ slar ma ldog cig /ces brjod do/ /de'o don ni/ nam mkha' la ltos dang zhes bya ba ni ma byas pa'i rig pa ye shes kyi lha ngo bstan pa yin/

yang nam mkha' na nyi ma la shes pa gtod pa ni/ de nyid ye shes lnga'i snang ba yin pas de las phyir ma ldog cig ces pa'i brda' yin no/ /lnga pa rig pa mngon sum gyi brda' dbang dngos ni/ langs te gyad kyi dor thabs 'dug /mdzub mo bsgrengs te mig btsugs la/ a a zhes brjod phyogs bzhir blta/ yang ni mdzub mo nam mkhar bsgrengs/ /mig ni har po dag tu blta/ /ngag tu nam mkha' 'di ni rgya che'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de rnams kyi don ni/ bla mas g.yas brkyang ba ni 'khor ba'i spros pa/ g.yon bskum pa ni 'das pa'i snang ba/ bag yangs su spyod cig pa'i brda'o/ /mdzub mo bsgrengs nas mig la btsugs te phyogs bzhir blta ba ni/ rig pa mngon sum gyi snang ba/ nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba/ rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba/ chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba ste/ snang ba bzhi rim pas 'char ba'i brda'o/ /mdzub mo nam mkhar bsgrengs pa ni/ rig pa lu gu rgyud mkha' la snang ba'i brda'o/ /mig har por lta ba ni lta stangs 'di ltar yin pa'i brda'o/ /nam mkha' 'di ni 'di ltar rgya che'o zhes pa ni 'di ltar byas pas snang ba 'di rang zad la 'gro bas ye shes kyi snang ba skye ba'i brda'o/ /de rnams kyis dngos gzhi'i gdams ngag bstan nas / de ltar brda dbang bskur dus su/ / nyams su myong ba lhag tu skye/ /gal te ma skyes srid na yang*/ /de dag brda ni bla mas bkrol/ /so so'i nyams dang mthun par bshad/ / ces gsungs kyang 'dir brda rnams zhor la bkrol lo/ /rje sa kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs dang gtor ma gtong*/ yon dbul lo/ /de nas ngo sprod pa'am dbang gong ma byed na/ de nas rnal du 'bebs pa yi/ / cho ga mkhas pas zhag gsum bya'o/ /de nas sems kyi sna khrid pa'i/ / sngon 'gro rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas rang gzhan gyi lta sgom spyod pa drug skor gyi man ngag rnams bstan par bya ste/ sems sbyangs la/

de nas rab tu spros med kyi dbang gis lung bstan cing dbugs dbyung bar bya'o/ /shin tu spros pa med pa'i dbang slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ bi ma la'i rgyab yig bsres nas rang byung rdo rjes bsgrigs pa rdzogs so// // oṃḥ.āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (3)shin tu spros med kyi dbang*/ -PAGE 352--PAGE 351--PAGE 344-
